entities.name: Bagrat VI of Georgia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bagrat VI, a representative of the Imeretian branch of the Bagrationi dynasty, was a king (mepe) of Imereti from 1463, and a king of Georgia from 1466 until his death.
